name: agentpay
description: ENSv2-discovered invoice extraction paid through Blocky402 on Hedera Testnet

scripts.build: npm run build -w @agentpay/core && npm run build -w @agentpay/server && npm run build -w @agentpay/web
scripts.dev: concurrently -k -n server,web -c blue,green "npm run dev -w @agentpay/server" "npm run dev -w @agentpay/web"
scripts.start: concurrently -k -n server,web "npm run start -w @agentpay/server" "npm run start -w @agentpay/web"
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w @agentpay/core && npm run build -w @agentpay/core && npm run typecheck -w @agentpay/server && npm run typecheck -w @agentpay/web && tsc -p tsconfig.json --noEmit
